whatsappMessage:
Hi Phone Hub team,

I noticed your mobile repair shop has solid 3.8★ reviews in Boring Road, Patna, but lacked a dedicated mobile booking page for quick customer inquiries.

Maine aapke store ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp repair quote booking, price list, aur location map integrate kiya hai:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/phonehub

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Phone Hub team, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke business ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp repair booking and fast mobile access for customers in Boring Road. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko concept pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact services, actual photos aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
